name: PressTrail
author: siaccslv

sections.description:
PressTrail gives you a Press menu for the coverage you get, and a block that lists it, newest first. The same list works for podcast appearances, talks and interviews you gave, awards you received, or a short list of your publications.

What the plugin does:

  • One entry per mention. The headline, the outlet or programme, the date and a link, kept apart from your posts and pages.
  • Dates from a calendar. Pick the day a mention appeared; the list shows it in your site’s date format, or one you pick under Press → Settings.
  • Fill from link. Paste the article’s link and click Fill from link: the headline, outlet and date are read from the page and written into the fields you left empty. Anything you typed stays as it is.
  • All the places a story ran. One mention, one main link, and as many more links as you need: the clip on TikTok, Instagram, Threads, Facebook or YouTube. Links to known sites are named after them automatically.
  • Types for separate lists. Mark each mention as Press, Podcast, Talk or Award, or types you add yourself, and show one list per type, or several types together, with the type next to each outlet. Mentions without a type still appear in lists that show every type. Switch on Let visitors filter by type to put a button for each type above the list.
  • A block for any page. Show all mentions or only the latest few, with or without dates, and choose the label for links to sites the plugin does not recognise.
  • Theme friendly. The list uses .pressm-* classes and a small base stylesheet. Themes can add their own icons for each site with the presstrail_link_icon filter.

For developers: presstrail_networks changes which sites links are recognised as, and presstrail_link_icon adds an icon before a link’s label.

External services

The Fill from link button on a mention’s edit screen reads the page the mention links to. Only when an editor clicks it, your site, not the editor’s browser, fetches that one page from its own server, as any visit would, and reads the headline, outlet and date from it. The request carries your site’s IP address, and your site’s address in the User-Agent. No other data is sent, and no third-party service is involved: the request goes only to the site the link points to, and that site’s own terms and privacy policy apply. Answers are cached for a day. Nothing is fetched from the public pages.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Add mentions under Press.
  3. Add the Press Mentions block to a page.
sections.faq:
Can I keep talks and press coverage apart?

Yes. Give each mention a type, and on each block tick the types it should show. Edit the list of types under Press → Types; Press, Podcast, Talk and Award are created when the plugin is first activated.

Are mentions public pages?

No. They only appear where you place the block.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • First release in the plugin directory: mentions with any number of extra links, types with an optional visitor filter, and Fill from link.

short_description: Keep a list of articles, broadcasts, podcasts, talks and awards about you or your project, and show it on any page with a block.
